blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Cebu Institute of Technology-University (CIT-U) Wildcats pulled off a 69-45 victory in the Cesafi basketball tournament over the University of the Philippines (UP) Cebu Fighting Maroons on Saturday, November 14, at the Cebu Coliseum. With the win, the Wildcats strengthened their Final Four bid in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament. They improved to an 8-4 (win-loss) record to remain in fourth place in the team standings. They also stretched their winning streak to four games.
